answered.sql: SELECT Name, Location FROM Beach_Clubs WHERE Beach_id = (SELECT id FROM Beaches WHERE PhoneNumber = '555-555-5555') UNION SELECT name, Item FROM Watersports_Rentals WHERE Beach_id = (SELECT id FROM Beaches WHERE PhoneNumber = '555-555-5555')

candidates.meaning: Find beach clubs and water sport rentals where the beach's phone number is 555-555-5555.
candidates.sql: SELECT T1.id, T1.Name, T1.Location, T1.OpeningHours, T1.PriceRange, T2.id AS Watersports_Rental_id, T2.name, T2.Item, T2.RentalRate, T2.AvailableDays FROM Beach_Clubs AS T1 JOIN Watersports_Rentals AS T2 ON T1.Beach_id = T2.Beach_id JOIN Beaches AS T3 ON T1.Beach_id = T3.id WHERE T3.PhoneNumber = '555-555-5555'
